name: OR-06
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by 6 points and the 2024 environment favors Democrats
Incumbent Andrea Salinas holds a huge financial advantage ($1.6M raised vs $13K)
Prediction markets price Democratic win odds around 96%
No public polls or expert ratings, so the forecast rests on fundamentals
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Salinas: a Democratic-leaning district, a favorable national environment, incumbency, and an overwhelming fundraising edge over David Russ, who has raised almost nothing. Markets agree, pricing her near 96%, so the race stays Safe D with wide uncertainty given the absence of polling.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a much tighter race or major outside spending against Salinas would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Oregon's 6th District leans Democratic, and first-term incumbent Andrea Salinas is running for reelection with a decisive financial edge. She has raised about $1.6 million and holds over $600,000 on hand, while Republican David Russ has raised roughly $13,000 with almost no cash remaining and no visible outside support.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, the favorable Democratic environment, and prediction markets, which price a Democratic win near 96%. The expected margin is about 20 points, though uncertainty is wider than usual because direct polling evidence is absent.
